text:
emi: Hey folks, first day here — I can get into the console but Grafana shows several panels as "Permission denied" and Datadog dashboards load but one monitor says "restricted". Who do I ping to get observability access? :wave:
devex-bot: Welcome to Redwood! To get Grafana/Datadog/Sentry access, please confirm your Redwood email and which projects/dashboards you need; #devex or #eng-sre can help.
ryan: @emi welcome! Post your email and which dashboards/monitors you need. Most access is via Okta groups (infra-observability, sentry-read).
emi: emi@redwood.com. Need: infra-summary dashboard, model-serving-latency dashboard, and Datadog monitors for model-serving and gpu-queue.
ryan: Added you to `infra-observability` group. Sign out of Okta and sign back in for group to propagate. If Grafana still denies, ping me with the panel IDs.
emi: Signed out/in and refreshed. Some panels still show: "requires role: observability.viewer"
priya: Heads up — a couple Grafana panels use a restricted Prometheus datasource token we only grant per-request. If you need long-term view, file infra-accounts ticket listing dashboards/panels; I can also share a view-only snapshot for your first week.
ryan: Also gave `monitor_read` to the Datadog viewer role for standard monitors. Try refreshing Datadog.
emi: Datadog shows model-serving monitors now, but `gpu-queue-latency` is still restricted (owner: ml-platform).
ml-platform: Adding infra-observability as watcher on that monitor now. Also created Sentry request for emi -> ticket #2045 so you get `sentry-read` on model-serving project.
emi: All visible now, and got Sentry ticket confirmation. Thanks everyone — much appreciated! :tada:
